card.name: "as" after count or classify verbs
card.fires_on: The word "as" right after verbs like count, counted, counts or classified, where something is being categorized. Also "for" after "control" in statistical studies.

modes.label: Categorizing "as"
modes.description: "as" following count, counted or classified, introducing the category something belongs to.
modes.example: this session will count<< as>> one of your 2 required trainings

modes.label: Control for
modes.description: "for" following "control" or "controlled" when naming a factor held constant in a study.
modes.example: He also controlled<< for>> people being born in better times, marital
